messages:
Lena (People Ops): Posting the follow-up from today's all-hands HR segment about hybrid schedules, offsite reimbursements, and workspace access. Drop any clarifying q's here.
Sam (VP Eng): Quick ask 1: are we moving to mandatory core days or keeping it flexible? Some teams want a fixed day for syncs.
Lena (People Ops): Not mandatory company-wide. We recommend a 1day core (e.g., Tue) plus team-determined overlap. Teams should note core days in their team page by May 5.
Priya (Sales): If someone's traveling for customer meetings, can they use hoteling at HQ on the same day they fly in to avoid long commutes?
Jorge (Facilities): Yes, hoteling available same-day inbound for business travel. Book via /hoteling and choose "business travel" tag so we reserve a flexible desk.
Sam (VP Eng): Are coworking / day pass expenses covered when people travel for focused work (not an offsite)?
expense-bot: Policy snippet: coworking/day-pass reimbursable up to $40/day with manager pre-approval. Upload receipt to Expensify with tag "coworking".
Priya (Sales): What about partner entertainment vs team offsite dinners  different limits?
Nora (Legal): Two categories: client/partner entertainment (reimbursable with business justification, $250 cap without pre-approval) vs internal team meals during an offsite (covered by offsite budget, no per-person cap but reasonable spend expected). Keep receipts.
Lena (People Ops): Offsite organizer note: there is a $1,200 planning stipend per team to cover meeting rooms, snacks, and local transport. Submit plan to people_ops@redwood before confirming vendors.
Sam (VP Eng): How do we handle childcare for parents who must travel? Any stipend?
Lena (People Ops): We have a dependent-care travel stipend up to $200/day for documented childcare incurred because of required business travel. Pre-approve with manager and People Ops.
Priya (Sales): Do managers need to approve flights that are refundable vs non-refundable?
Jorge (Facilities): We strongly prefer refundable or flexible fares for unpredictable travel. If booking non-refundable to save cost, get manager sign-off and note in travel form.
expense-bot: Reminder: all travel >$600 require travel-form submission + manager sign-off 7 days before departure.
Sam (VP Eng): Can teams run co-located "focus weeks" and expense local lunch + conference rooms?
Lena (People Ops): Yes, focus weeks are supported. Use the focus-week template in the handbook, get manager ok, and expense meals under the team offsite bucket.
Nora (Legal): Quick legal note: if external vendors are present at an offsite and NDAs are needed, coordinate with legal at least 10 business days ahead.
Lena (People Ops): Action items: 1) People Ops to publish an "organizer checklist" for offsites by Apr 10; 2) Facilities to add a "business travel" hoteling tag by Apr 3; 3) Finance to update Expensify categories for coworking and dependent-care by Apr 8. I'll post links when live.
Priya (Sales): Thanks 44d very helpful.
Sam (VP Eng): Appreciate the clarity.
Lena (People Ops): If you have specific edge cases, DM me or ping people_ops. We'll keep this thread updated.
